subject: spanish
title: Stamp 1: Outbreak of the Civil War
welcome_lead: Stamp the start of the Spanish Civil War in 1936.
meta_desc: A-Level Spanish adventure on the 1936 outbreak and the Republican-Nationalist divide.

concepts.def: Spanish Civil War 1936-1939 between Republicans and Nationalists.
Republican side; defenders of the Second Republic, including socialists, communists, anarchists.
Nationalist side; rebel military backed by conservatives, Carlists, and Falangists.
Second Republic 1931-1939; reforming democracy overthrown by the coup.
Military uprising of 18 July 1936 that triggered the civil war.
Popular Front; left-wing electoral coalition that won February 1936 elections.

walkthroughs.body_html: Proclaimed in April 1931, the Republic pursued land reform, women's suffrage, and secular education. Polarisation grew; the Popular Front's narrow win in February 1936 hardened opposition.
On 17-18 July 1936, generals revolted in Morocco and Spain. The coup succeeded only partially. The country split into Republican and Nationalist zones, beginning a brutal three-year war.
Republicans: socialists (PSOE), communists (PCE), anarchists (CNT), POUM, regional nationalists. Nationalists: rebel army, monarchists (Carlists), Falangists, Catholic conservatives.
